title: TRIALMON safety review console
summary: Review uploaded study safety data through a ranked worklist, liver convention grid, QTcF categories, CTCAE lab shifts, adverse-event counts and an illustrative DLT rule reference. Guided file mapping requires study-specific schedules, thresholds and coding conventions. The console flags positions for medical review; it does not adjudicate cases or decide dose escalation.
try: Choose study CSVs or download blank input templates; map columns and enter the study screening conventions.
Validate and open the workspace, inspect every safety panel, and save the complete inputs, settings and outputs.
For a guided demonstration, deliberately load the fictional CP-101 example; the participant IDs below belong only to that example.

screenshot.alt: The TRIALMON console as it opens: the packet for participant CP101-014 (RED) in the sidebar; the Start here card with what the console shows, every rule behind RED, AMBER and watch, and four things to try; seven value boxes (overall RED, participants and cohorts RED, study tier AMBER, 5 RED and 7 AMBER flags, 2 watch, 18 dosed participants); and the top of the ranked worklist.
